newsitem.title: UK: UK wheat futures rally towards close, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: UK wheat futures rally towards close, trade thin.

text.p: UK wheat futures rallied towards the close of business on Tuesday on a thinly traded market.

Wheat futures started the post-holiday session lower with values as much as 0.50 stg down at the end of the morning session. But by the close values were 0.50 to 0.20 stg higher mainly on short covering, traders said.
Barley finished mixed at 0.25 stg down to 0.10 stg up after trading 115 lots.
In Amsterdam the milling wheat futures contact closed unchanged after trading one lot.
Activity on the cash market was limited.
"The market was either going to restart with a bang or a whimper after the holiday and the whimper won," said a trader.
"Sellers tried to push the fob market up and that frightened most of the cash market buyers off," the trader added.
Traders reported no fob business and few markets while deliveried trade was virtually at a standstill.
"The harvest is still stop-go owing to the weather and the market is matching it," said one trader.
